what: The button face sits stacked on a back plate. On hover it lifts 4px to the upper left so the back plate shows like a shadow, and the arrow drops 3px (.45s). On press it snaps back in place in 80ms. The Glow type doesn’t lift, it always wears an accent-colored glow (9px) and scales to 1.04 (.15s, .98 on press). The Quiet type neither lifts nor changes color and stays in place.

options.look: “glow” (always-on light + 1.04x) · “quiet” (no motion), if omitted, it lifts

note: Re-measured the 2026-10-29 original with motion-probe in calculation style and fixed it — lift .42→.45s, glow changed from an 18px hover spread to a constant 9px ring plus 1.04x scale over .15s (cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)), and quiet set to no motion because the original ← Full product link keeps its color on hover
